description:
Executive Assistant \- LE4 \- DFAT \- Geneva  
Application Deadline: August 26, 2026\.  
Department: DFAT \- Geneva.  
Employment Type: Permanent \- Full Time.  
Location: Australian Permanent Mission, Geneva  
Workplace: Onsite  
Compensation and Benefits: CHF 95,784 / yeat, 20 days annual leave, 50% employer contribution to health insurance and accident insurance, and to a retirement fund.  
Applications are sought from persons interested in employment within the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva.  
The successful applicant will be engaged as a locally engaged staff member by the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva.  
Please be advised that the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva does not assist with relocation. Any costs associated with taking up the position would be the responsibility of the successful candidate.  
A standard probity check will be undertaken prior to commencement for the successful applicant.  
Executive Assistant \- LE4 \- DFAT \- Geneva  
About The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade  
The role of the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) is to advance the interests of Australia and Australians internationally. This involves strengthening Australia’s security, enhancing Australia’s prosperity, delivering an effective and high\-quality overseas aid program and helping Australian travellers and Australians overseas. The department provides foreign, trade and development policy advice to the Australian Government. DFAT also works with other Australian Government agencies to drive coordination of Australia’s pursuit of global, regional and bilateral interests.  
About the Position  
Under direction, the Executive Assistant to the Ambassador and Deputy Ambassador provides high\-level executive, administrative and organisational support at the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva. The position also organises official events and functions.  
Due to the sensitive nature of the work involved, this position will need to be able to hold and maintain a national security clearance recognised by DFAT.  
Key responsibilities of the position include but are not limited to:  
Provide high\-level executive support to the Ambassador and Deputy Ambassador, ensuring the effective operation of executive offices in a fast\-paced and sensitive environment.  
Manage and prioritise correspondence, invitations, briefing materials and requests, exercising sound judgement to determine priority, action and compliance requirements.  
Coordinate official visits and delegation programs for Ministers, senior officials and high\-level visitors, balancing competing priorities and operational requirements.  
Plan and deliver representational events, meetings and official engagements, liaising with internal and external stakeholders to achieve Mission objectives.  
Manage representational expenditure and financial administration, including forecasting, acquittals, reconciliations and reporting in accordance with DFAT policies and procedures.  
Coordinate travel, logistics and related administrative arrangements for executive leadership and official activities, ensuring compliance with relevant policies and procedures.  
Monitor security, operational and workflow risks, implementing required controls and escalating issues as appropriate.  
Provide administrative guidance, maintain effective business systems and support team coordination, contributing to continuous improvement and organisational effectiveness.  
Required Qualifications/Experience/Knowledge/Skills  
Proven experience in similar Executive Assistant role/s  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills  
Ability to work with and support a team. Ability to develop and maintain respectful and effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders  
Ability to manage time, prioritise, plan, handle multiple tasks and work well under pressure  
Financial management and organisational skills  
Discretion and sound judgement in handling confidential information  
Extensive experience using Microsoft Office and electronic applications  
Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills  
Fluency in English is required, with fluency in French highly regarded  
Knowledge of, or an ability to quickly acquire a knowledge of Australian Government legislation or departmental policy and guidelines in relation to the position duties  
Desirable  
Previous experience working in an embassy, international organisation, or comparable environment.  
Security Requirements  
Australian NV2 security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain this. Therefore applicants must hold Australian citizenship to be considered.  
Please note that candidates who hold citizenship or dual citizenship of Switzerland are not eligible for an Australian Security Clearance.  
How to Apply  
Where the application form asks for a cover letter, please provide a written pitch of no more than 500 words demonstrating your suitability to perform the key responsibilities of the position. Your pitch is your opportunity to tell us why you are the right candidate for the role. It will be assessed on your ability to demonstrate, or have the potential to develop, the required skills, knowledge, experience and qualifications to proficiently perform the role. Relevant examples and accomplishments will strengthen your application. Please attach a copy of your pitch with your CV.  
The Fair Work Act 2009 is not intended to apply to the employment of Locally Engaged Staff (LES) at Australia’s overseas diplomatic and consular missions. The successful candidate’s terms and conditions of employment will be governed by the laws of Switzerland.

title: Social Media & Community Engagement Officer
description:
Join MSF OCG as a Social Media & Community Engagement Officer in Geneva!
We are looking for passionate candidates ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission.
Below, you will find the job details and the qualifications we are looking for.
Inclusivity and Diversity at MSF
Do your qualifications and experience not exactly match all requirements of the job?
At MSF OCG, we are committed to an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff members. We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF's social mission and create better outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with.
We understand that some people may hesitate to apply for employment if they don't meet all listed job requirements. Research shows that this is especially true for women. If you believe your profile is a good match for this position, we invite you to apply even if you don’t fulfil every listed qualification.
We encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, background, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.
MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will undergo reference checks.

Context & mission
Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).
The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers.
The mission is to develop and implement MSF Switzerland's organic social media approach for French-speaking audiences, strengthening audience engagement and supporting broader digital supporter journeys. Ensure social media channels contribute to awareness, engagement, advocacy and supporter acquisition through relevant content, community engagement and platform-specific practices.

Tasks & Responsibilities
Define and implement the organic social media approach : define and implement the organic social media strategy for French-speaking audiences, ensuring channel priorities, editorial choices and audience engagement support MSF Switzerland's digital engagement objectives.
Develop and maintain social media standards and playbooks: develop and continuously improve platform-specific playbooks, editorial standards and community engagement practices to ensure consistency, quality and effective use of social media channels.
Lead social media editorial planning and content adaptation: lead the planning, adaptation and editorial framing of social media content, ensuring messages are relevant, accessible and aligned with audience needs, organisational priorities and platform requirements.
Monitor and optimise social media performance: in collaboration with the digital analyst, analyse performance data, audience insights and engagement trends to identify opportunities, improve content effectiveness and refine social media approaches.
Manage and strengthen online communities: manage community engagement across priority social media channels, fostering meaningful interactions and encouraging audiences to take appropriate actions within the broader digital engagement journey.
Coordinate digital initiatives: coordinate and contribute to digital projects, campaigns and activations, ensuring alignment between social media activities and wider digital communication objectives.
Contribute to digital innovation and knowledge sharing: identify emerging trends, platform developments and best practices, translating insights into recommendations that enhance digital engagement activities and organisational learning.
Supervise and support the Digital Engagement Unit intern: supervise, guide and develop the French-speaking Digital Engagement Unit intern, ensuring quality delivery, skill development and alignment with team priorities.

Your profile
Education
Bachelor's degree in digital communication, digital marketing or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

Experience

Experience developing and implementing organic social media strategies, editorial planning and platform-specific content approaches.

Knowledge of organic social media management, particularly Facebook, Instagram and YouTube.
Understanding of audience engagement, content performance and social media analytics.
Understanding of platform trends, content formats and community management practices.
Awareness of humanitarian communication principles and sensitive operational contexts.
Editorial judgement and content adaptation.
Audience engagement and relationship building.
Analytical and problem-solving skills.
Planning and project coordination.
Collaboration and stakeholder management.
Adaptability in changing environments.
Creativity and trends adaptation.

About us  
The Space Research and Planetary Sciences Division (WP) at the University of Bern has been at the forefront of space research for over 50 years. Since conducting its first experiment on the Moon as part of the Apollo 11 mission, the division has participated in numerous missions led by major space agencies such as ESA, NASA, and JAXA.  
The Space Research and Planetary Sciences Division at the University of Bern is seeking a skilled and motivated Test or Electrical Engineer to support ongoing work with the ground reference model of NIM (Neutral and Ion Mass spectrometer), part of ESA's JUICE (JUpiter ICy moons Explorer) mission. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute directly to the engineering, testing, and scientific support of one of Europe's premier planetary science missions.

The successful candidate will play a central role in supporting the development, testing, and operation of NIM, including:  
Planning and conducting calibrations and tests of the instrument under various operational conditionsLeading the diagnosis, troubleshooting, and repair of hardware and system issuesCharacterizing and optimizing critical components and subsystemsParticipating in the development and validation of operation and software tools

Maintaining and improving technical documentation, including design and operations manuals

A higher education degree (ETH, Uni, FH) in engineering, physics, or a related technical field  
Experience with laboratory instrumentation and electronic diagnostics  
Proficiency in coding in and/or C\+\+ or similar  
A motivated, hands\-on, and collaborative approach to problem\-solving (team player)  
Proficient written English skills required; basic knowledge of German is desirable.  
We offer  
A dynamic and collaborative environment at one of Europe's leading space research institutes  
Involvement in a high\-profile international space mission (ESA's JUICE mission)  
Opportunities to grow technical and scientific expertise in a cutting\-edge laboratory  
Highly interdisciplinary work environment (including mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, and software engineering)  
Flexible working arrangements and support for professional development  
The position is initially for one year with the possibility of extension.  
Your Benefits

Team\-oriented work

Strong research infrastructure and international network  
Working at the University of Bern

In the Engineering and Integration team, we connect what's separated, secure what matters, and reveal what's hidden, while shaping how integration, identity, and security work in a world of Agentic AI, hybrid delivery, and Zero Trust. We're modernising our identity platform around Keycloak, embedding Zero Trust and fine\-grained authorization as the default, and building the identity foundations for an AI\-augmented enterprise.  
We're looking for an experienced professional who leads through concepts, direction, and judgment, preparing Zurich Switzerland for what's next, by ensuring a future\-ready, cost\-efficient application landscape that scales as our business evolves \- in an era where engineering value increasingly lies in judgment.  
You'll work closely with our Senior Product Owner/Architect, Engineers, and Specialists, as the person who moves things forward, technologically, methodologically and conceptually.  
We're an agile, collaborative team with a strong network across Business Unit Switzerland. Together with all IT departments, we combine deep technical expertise with a clear focus on delivery and outstanding service to our stakeholders.  
If you love solving hard problems, communicate with clarity and empathy, and thrive in multidisciplinary teams, this role is exactly right for you.  
Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is among the "Top 3" companies in Switzerland. Become a part of it and apply as Senior Platform Engineer \- Identity \& Security.  
What you will do  
Set the technical direction for how our team engineers identity and security in an era where coding shifts toward becoming a commodity, through concepts, principles, and reference architectures that others in the team and beyond will build on and bring the team along on that journey  
Shape the evolution and operations of our Enterprise Identity Platform (strategic focus: Keycloak), including OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML, and PKCE, while steering the phase out of our legacy federation and extend our security posture into event\-driven and AI\-augmented workflows  
Develop and articulate the target picture for identity and security in the age of Agentic AI, from access management and security concepts for AI agents, agentic workflows, and workload identity, to fine\-grained authorization (OpenFGA, OPA, Cedar) and Zero Trust  
Set engineering standards, reviews, and quality gates across internal teams, partners, and AI\-augmented workflows \- ensuring quality, security, and knowledge transfer  
Partner with business domains and Digital Products to translate insurance requirements into robust identity and security outcomes  
What you bring  
7\+ years in software or security engineering \- ideally in insurance, banking, or a related financial services industry \- with deep expertise in modern authentication (OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML, PKCE, token lifecycle, federation, LDAP) and hands\-on Keycloak experience  
Hands\-on experience with Agentic AI access management and security concepts (agent identity, agent\-to\-agent auth, MCP security, prompt injection defense, supply chain security for AI components) and a critical eye for the limitations of AI\-augmented development (Copilot, , agentic workflows)  
Solid understanding of fine\-grained authorization (OpenFGA, OPA, Cedar), Zero Trust, and cloud\-native engineering (Azure and/or AWS, containers, event streaming)  
Strong sense of E2E ownership, business curiosity, ability to translate business intent into technical specifications, critical thinking and reflection, and ability to apply principles, name risks, surface trade\-offs and manage ambiguity, paired with strong communication skills that earn trust and bring senior engineers along  
Fluent in English, both spoken and written, German is a plus

Die Praxis ist Teil eines etablierten ambulanten Gesundheitsnetzwerks und vereint Hausarztmedizin sowie Physiotherapie unter einem Dach. Patientinnen und Patienten profitieren dadurch von kurzen Wegen und einer engen interprofessionellen Zusammenarbeit. Sie arbeiten in der Bodensee\-Region, einer der beliebtesten Wohn\- und Freizeitregionen der Ostschweiz. Der Bodensee liegt praktisch vor der Haustür und prägt das Lebensgefühl der Region: Spaziergänge am Wasser, Segeln, Velotouren oder ein Feierabend mit Blick auf den See gehören hier zum Alltag. Gleichzeitig profitieren Sie von einer ausgezeichneten Verkehrsanbindung sowie der unmittelbaren Nähe zu Deutschland und Österreich. Die Region verbindet hohe Lebensqualität mit einem attraktiven Arbeitsumfeld.

Hausärztliche Betreuung von Patientinnen und Patienten aller Altersgruppen  
Diagnostik und Therapie akuter sowie chronischer Erkrankungen  
Durchführung von Vorsorgeuntersuchungen und Gesundheitschecks  
Langfristige Begleitung von Patientinnen und Patienten im ambulanten Setting  
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Physiotherapie und weiteren Gesundheitsfachpersonen  
Aktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung des Standorts  
Ihre Kompetenzen:  
Facharzttitel Allgemeine Innere Medizin, Praktischer Arzt oder ein äquivalenter Abschluss, insbesondere der deutsche Facharzttitel Allgemeinmedizin  
Deutschkenntnisse auf Niveau C1  
Freude an einer langfristigen hausärztlichen Tätigkeit  
Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise  
Teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit hoher Sozialkompetenz

Schwerpunkt Mammographie: Eigenverantwortliche und empathische Durchführung von Mammographien auf höchstem technischem Niveau sowie Betreuung der Patientinnen während des gesamten Untersuchungsablaufs.

Persönlichkeit: Hohe Sozialkompetenz, Empathie im Umgang mit Patienten sowie eine zuverlässige, selbstständige und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise.
Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Attraktive Vergütung: Schweizer Gehaltsstandard inklusive hervorragender Sozialleistungen und Vorsorgekonzepte.

title: Security Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace (IT-Administrator/in)
description:
Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

Secruity Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace

- Do you want to design modern Microsoft 365 environments holistically and advise customers on everything from collaboration strategy to security, compliance, and Copilot?
- Are you equally comfortable with technical and conceptual topics and ready to take ownership in diverse customer projects?
- Are you looking for an environment where you can work cross-functionally, help shape innovation, and create real value together with Sales, Delivery, and technology partners?

Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-100 – Cybersecurity Architect Expert
- SC-300 – Identity and Access Administrator
- SC-200 – Security Operations Analyst
- SC-400 – Information Protection Administrator
- AZ-500 – Azure Security Engineer
- MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator
- Additional Microsoft Security, Azure, Purview, Sentinel, Copilot or Security Copilot etc. certifications are a plus

Our company benefits vary based on your location, but always include:

- Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture (https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values)
- A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action
- President’s Club: Recognition awarded by leadership and your peers
- Flexible work: Do great work from anywhere but also visit local office to deliver excellence in team relationship
- Lifelong education: A variety of training and development opportunities
- Hire to Grow: We optimize our internal structures and feedback culture constantly to be your Employer of Choice, today and in future
- You can find all current benefits here: https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits (https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits)

Then apply with your CV and a few clicks via our online form! No cover letter is necessary.

Do you have any questions? Then feel free to send us an email at malte.ruetten@softwareone.com.

title: IT-Projektleiter/in
description:
IT\-Projektleiter/in  
Mittelschul\- und Berufsbildungsamt  
IT\-Projektleiter/in 80 \- 100%  
Gestalten Sie die digitale Zukunft der Bildung mit  
Das Mittelschul\- und Berufsbildungsamt des Kantons Zürich (MBA) engagiert sich im Interesse von Jugend, Politik und Wirtschaft für die kantonalen Mittel\- und Berufsfachschulen, die Anbieter von Berufsvorbereitungsjahren und die Lehrbetriebe. Gemeinsam mit internen und externen Partnern stellen wir für rund 60'000 Nutzerinnen und Nutzer an über 40 kantonalen Schulen einen modernen, auf die Anforderungen der Bildung ausgerichteten Informatik\-Service sicher.  
Unsere Organisationseinheit Digitales leistet damit einen zentralen Beitrag zum digitalen Wandel der Bildung. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams «Digitaler Wandel an kantonalen Schulen Sek II» (DiWaSek II) suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine IT\-Projektleiterin oder einen IT\-Projektleiter mit einem Pensum von 80\-100%.  
Ihr Aufgabengebiet  
Sie möchten etwas bewegen? Dann sind Sie bei uns richtig. In dieser Rolle gestalten Sie die digitale Transformation an den kantonalen Schulen der Sekundarstufe II aktiv mit. Sie konsolidieren, modernisieren und standardisieren die technischen und pädagogischen IKT\-Services und tragen dazu bei, dass unsere Migrationsprojekte termin\-, qualitäts\- und zielgerecht umgesetzt werden. Dabei fungieren Sie als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen den Schulen, internen und externen Leistungserbringern sowie weiteren Projektpartnern. In enger Abstimmung mit den weiteren Mitgliedern der Projektführung planen, führen und koordinieren Sie die Migrationsprojekte und übernehmen bei Bedarf auch operative Aufgaben. Mit Ihrem Fachwissen und Ihren Erfahrungen leisten Sie einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung eines zeitgemässen digitalen Unterrichts. Ihr Einsatz kommt unmittelbar den Jugendlichen, Lehrpersonen, Schulleitungen und der Schulverwaltung zugute.  
Ihr Profil  
Für diese Aufgabe bringen Sie ein abgeschlossenes Studium als Informatikerin oder Informatiker, Wirtschaftsinformatikerin oder Wirtschaftsinformatiker HF/FH oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit. Sie verfügen über Erfahrungen in der Projektleitung, idealerweise mit Kenntnissen in HERMES und ITIL, und agieren gerne als Bindeglied zwischen den verschiedenen Stakeholdern. Dabei haben Sie Freude daran, komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich zu machen und in konkrete Lösungen zu übersetzen. Ihre Arbeitsweise ist strukturiert, gleichzeitig aber auch lösungsorientiert und von einer ausgeprägten Hands\-on\-Mentalität geprägt. Sie kommunizieren proaktiv, arbeiten gerne interdisziplinär und verfügen über eine stilsichere Ausdrucksweise in Deutsch, sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich.  
Unser Angebot  
Wir bieten Ihnen ein motiviertes, dynamisches Team, das gemeinsam anpackt, sowie eine sinnstiftende Aufgabe mit unmittelbarem Nutzen für die Bildung. Sie übernehmen eine entwicklungsfähige Position mit Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung, profitieren von zeitgemässen Arbeitsbedingungen sowie flexiblen Arbeitsformen und arbeiten an einem attraktiven Standort in Zürich in Gehdistanz zum Hauptbahnhof.

title: Auxiliaire de santé
description:
Auxiliaire de santé (H/F)  
Nos centres Médico\-Sociaux (CMS) offrent à la population Lausannoise des prestations pluridisciplinaires de qualité et leurs interventions reposent sur des valeurs d’humanité et d’équité.  
En rejoignant la Fondation Soins Lausanne, vous vous engagez de ère concrète en faveur de la santé et du bien\-vivre dans le canton de Vaud, au sein d’équipes expertes, motivées et enthousiastes, dans une activité variée et riche en contacts humains.  
Sur le terrain, vous intervenez sur le lieu de vie ou d’activité des bénéficiaires. Vous définissez avec les clients les solutions les plus adaptées à leurs situations et développez ainsi une connaissance fine et une relation de confiance privilégiée avec eux. Faisant partie d’une équipe soudée et soutenante, l’exercice de ces métiers permet une grande autonomie mais nécessite de grandes responsabilités et une flexibilité de la part de nos collaborateurs.  
Afin de compléter nos équipes, les CMS de la Fondation Soins Lausanne recherche de suite ou à convenir plusieurs :  
Auxiliaire de santé (H/F)  
Taux d'activité entre 50% et 80%  
Contrat fixe à durée indeterminée  
Votre mission  
Assurer les prestations de soins de base, d’hygiène et de confort dans les activités quotidiennes et d’aide au maintien de l’ordre et de la propreté dans le milieu de vie  
Surveiller l’état général des clients et transmettre des observations utiles à la prise en charge de qualité dans la continuité des soins  
Stimuler et soutenir les clients et leurs proches en maintenant au maximum leur autonomie et leur qualité de vie en fonction de leurs capacités  
Offrir une écoute et développer un lien relationnel et de confiance  
Collaborer activement aux activités des équipes interdisciplinaires avec un rôle propre vous permettant de valoriser votre métier d’auxiliaire de santé comme partie prenante à part entière du système de santé  
Votre profil et vos compétences  
Certificat d'auxiliaire de santé CRS 120 heures ou certification jugée équivalente (diplôme étranger reconnu par la CRS) ou volonté de suivre la formation  
Intérêt marqué pour l'âge avancé et le maintien à domicile  
Capacité à s'organiser de ère autonome tout en sachant collaborer en réseau et en pluridisciplinarité  
Expérience dans le domaine médico\-social et intérêt marqué pour la santé communautaire  
Sens des responsabilités et éthique professionnelle  
Maîtrise du français à l'oral et à l'écrit  
Bonne aisance avec les outils informatiques et la téléphonie mobile  
Nous offrons  
Un cadre de travail stimulant et chaleureux où l'autonomie du soignant est mise en avant  
Un environnement de travail qui privilègie le contact humain et l'échange  
Un travail passionnant dans un cadre agréable pour le bien\-être des clients  
Des conditions de travail et de rémunération équitables  
Des conditions de prévoyance professionnelle qui s’étendent au\-delà des prestations minimales prévues par la loi

L'équité salariale entre femmes et hommes (certification Fair\-ON\-Pay)

title: Supervisor Engine Shop Floor 100%
description:
We are a world leading Engine MRO service provider, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, with over 90 years of operational experience. Our unwavering dedication to innovation, excellence and environmental responsibility propels us forward on our journey to becoming the leading, most customer-centric, and sustainable Engine focused MRO worldwide.

Working with an extensive network of partners and business development offices in Europe, the USA, Asia and the Middle East, we offer comprehensive, fully customized solutions for the Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul of aircraft engines, airframes and components sales business including impeccable technical support to over 500 customers worldwide. Our mission: We safely power your flight.

We are looking for dedicated and skilled individuals to join our shop floor across several areas and departments at Zurich-Airport. If this sounds appealing to you, we encourage you to apply for our Supervisor position.

As a Supervisor Engine Shop Floor you will be responsible for the development and management of a highly effective Team of approximately 20 to 25 employees, striving for safety and quality, while delivering in time and on cost expectations. You will coordinate the team’s work with its direct stakeholders at SR Technics to the goals and missions of the organization.

Supervisor Engine Shop Floor 100%

Your tasks

- Promote a positive Safety Culture and ensure that Safety and Quality Policy are communicated/promoted and implemented within the Organization.
- Lead and manage a multi-cultural team, fostering performance, engagement, and a positive work environment.
- Drive performance culture through periodic target setting and regular structured follow up with all employees. Apply performance management process (PMP) and leadership with a focus on employee motivation.
- Plan and allocate resources to ensure high productivity and monitor labor efficiency
- Drive personnel development and skill management to meet capacity requirements (OJT, qualifications, certifications, performance evaluations).
- Execute and promote Continuous Improvements in applying Lean principles and 5S to achieve the organization targets and key performance indicators (KPI).
- Participate in, prepare for and be responsible for internal and external audits

Your Profile

- Technical background or technical education (aviation experience is a plus)
- Leadership experience with strong interpersonal skills and leadership skills with the ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams. Minimum 3 years team leadership or strong project leadership preferred.
- Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment and strong focus on safety, quality, and cost efficiency
- Proactive, independent, and self-initiated working style with high performance drive
- Knowledge and experience in applying Lean/Six Sigma methodology
- Proficient in English (B2+), German is an advantage
- Proficiency with maintenance documentation systems. Microsoft Office required, SAP is an advantage

title: Senior Consultant - Assurance - Technology Risk
description:
At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.  
We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.  
Senior Consultant \- Assurance \- Technology Risk  
The opportunity  
Our Consulting business offers a broad range of functional and cross\-country services dedicated to providing high\-value and trusted advice to clients, with a specific focus on business transformation programs.  
Your key responsibilities  
You will gain insights into cutting\-edge IT environments and into our global methodology. Your focus: analysis, evaluation and optimization of processes, structures and systems  
As a member of interdisciplinary specialist teams, you will audit operational IT systems and information portals with regard to internal control and risk and compliance management. This includes migration tests, third party attestation \& certification, IT risk assessments, information security assessments and data analytics/information management  
You will learn about "thought leadership" as a way of addressing today's constantly changing market and challenges. You will expand your expertise with every project alongside our leaders. Furthermore, you will be supported with trainings, courses and learnings in relevant fields

Degree (Bachelor or Master) in Economics or (Business\-) Information Technology is required, relevant certifications (e.g. CISA, CISSP, CISM or CRISC) are an advantage  
A must: 3\-4 years' experience in carrying out IT audits (e.g. at a Big4 company or internal audit department) or in the area of IT risk management / operational risk management, preferably at an international company  
Qualities guaranteed to boost your career at EY: ability to work in a team, determination, commitment and quick comprehension. As a Swiss international company, we require German and English

title: Sachbearbeiter Kundendienst DE 80-100%
description:
Sachbearbeiter Kundendienst DE 80\-100% (m/w/d)  
Digital Republic ist der innovative und flexible Provider für Mobile Abos und mobiles Internet in der Schweiz. Als Teil der mobilezone Gruppe arbeiten wir in Zürich (Schlieren) und verfolgen ein klares Ziel: Einfache Produkte mit einem starken Preis\-Leistungs\-Verhältnis und persönlichem Support. Bei uns erwartet dich ein junges und motiviertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, viel Eigenverantwortung und einer offenen Du\-Kultur. Du möchtest mitdenken, mitgestalten und wirklich etwas bewegen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.  
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Zürich (Schlieren) suchen wir dich als  
Sachbearbeiter Kundendienst DE 80\-100% (m/w/d)  
Deine Aufgaben  
Als Mitglied unseres Supportteams bist du bei uns die wichtige Ansprechperson für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und setzt deren Zufriedenheit an erste Stelle. Du hilfst bei Fragen, löst Probleme und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kundinnen und Kunden eine exzellente Erfahrung mit Digital Republic machen.  
Du bearbeitest Kundenanfragen via Telefon und Ticketingsystem auf Deutsch. ösisch und/oder Englisch wären ein Pluspunkt.  
Du unterstützt unsere Kundinnen und Kunden bei Fragen und berätst sie proaktiv rund um unsere Mobile\-, Home\- und Daten\-Abos.  
Du gibst Kundenfeedback intern weiter und trägst so zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Abos und interner Prozesse bei.  
Du unterstützt bei Backoffice\-Aufgaben und arbeitest mit anderen Teams innerhalb der Firma zusammen.  
Das bringst du mit  
Eine abgeschlossene Lehre im Bereich /\-frau, Kundendialog oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet.  
Du verfügst über mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Kundendienst. Viel wichtiger ist uns aber, dass du gerne mit Menschen kommunizierst, stets freundlich bleibst und auch bei mehreren gleichzeitigen Anfragen den Überblick behältst.  
Du schreibst und sprichst fliessend und stilsicher Deutsch. Gute ösisch\- und/oder Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.  
Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und genau. Du denkst mit und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung.  
Deine positive und kommunikative Persönlichkeit zeichnet dich aus und du hast Freude daran, Kundinnen und Kunden wirklich weiterzuhelfen.  
Du bist bereit, gelegentlich auch samstags zu arbeiten und dafür unter der Woche zu nehmen.  
Das bieten wir dir  
Ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld im Telekommunikationsbereich  
Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit fixen Büro\- und Homeoffice\-Tagen  
Eine kollegiale Atmosphäre mit Du\-Kultur und tollen Teamevents  
Ein kostenloses Digital Republic Mobile Abo  
Attraktive BVG\-Versicherungsleistungen  
Zentrale Lage in ZH (Schlieren) mit sehr guter ÖV\-Anbindung  
Die Möglichkeit, Ideen einzubringen und die Zukunft von Digital Republic aktiv mitzugestalten  
Interessiert?  
Dann freuen wir uns auf deine vollständige Bewerbung über unser Online\-Bewerbungssystem.

title: Senior Network Engineer 100%
description:
Stellen Sie Ihre berufliche Zukunft unter einen guten Stern.  
Merbag ist ein international agierendes Unternehmen mit 64 Standorten in 5 europäischen Ländern und beschäftigt rund 4400 Mitarbeitende. In der Schweiz ist Merbag mit 28 Standorten und rund 1400 Mitarbeitenden der grösste Mercedes\- Vertreter und drittgrösste Arbeitgeber der Automobilbranche.  
Als wichtigsten Erfolgsfaktor sehen wir unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter. Deswegen profitieren Sie bei Merbag von zeitgemässen, modernen Arbeitsbedingungen und zahlreichen Benefits.  
In dieser verantwortungsvollen Rolle als Senior Network Engineer 100% (m/w) übernehmen Sie per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung in unserem Dienstleistungszentrum Schlieren die Planung, Weiterentwicklung und den Betrieb internationaler Netzwerk\-Infrastrukturen. Sie gestalten moderne, sichere und hochverfügbare Kommunikationsnetzwerke und arbeiten eng mit internen IT\-Teams sowie externen Dienstleistern zusammen.  
Senior Network Engineer 100% (m/w)  
Ihre Aufgaben  
Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Systemarchitekturen für grosse IP\-basierte Kommunikationsnetzwerke (CISCO, Meraki, Nokia)  
Erarbeitung von Netzwerk\-, Sicherheits\- und Betriebskonzepten  
Planung von Hardware\-, Software\- und Infrastruktur\-Entwicklungsschritten  
Dokumentation von Konfigurationen, Netzdesigns und Sicherheitsarchitekturen  
Planung, Durchführung und Rollout von Netzwerk\-Infrastrukturen im In\- und Ausland  
3rd\-Level\-Support in den Bereichen LAN, WAN, WLAN, LTE, Firewall und Proxy  
Qualitätssicherung und Monitoring internationaler Leitungen (WAN Provider)  
Eröffnung, Koordination und Begleitung von Provider\-Tickets  
Betrieb, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung einer Laborumgebung  
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen IT\-Abteilungen, Fachbereichen und externen Dienstleistern  
Ihr Profil  
Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Informatiker/in EFZ, HF, FH oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation  
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich IT\-System\- und Enterprise\-Netzwerkarchitektur  
Fundiertes Know\-how als Senior Network Engineer im Bereich Routing\-Protokolle, LTE und Firewall\-Technologien  
Praxiserfahrung mit Technologien wie VLANs, VPNs, STP, DHCP, DNS, HSRP, NAT, IP\-Adressierung und NetFlow  
Erfahrung mit Segmentierung, , QoS, ZBF, VRF und OSPF  
Netzwerk\-Zertifizierungen, zum Beispiel Cisco CCNP oder vergleichbar, von Vorteil  
Hohe Eigenverantwortung, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen  
Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team  
Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen im In\- und Ausland, ca. 10%  
Sehr gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse  
Italienisch\- oder ösischkenntnisse von Vorteil  
Führerausweis Kategorie B  
Unsere Benefits  
Mindestens 5 Wochen Ferien, je nach Alter und Funktion im Unternehmen bis zu 6 Wochen  
Private Unfallversicherung mit weltweiter Deckung  
Monatlicher Sponsoringbeitrag beim Leasing eines Mercedes\- oder smart Neuwagens  
Beteiligung an einem Fitness\-Jahresabonnement  
Alle 5 Jahre finanzielle Anerkennung für Mitarbeitenden\-Treue  
Gestaltungsfreiraum, Verantwortung und Wertschätzung

Set up and maintain Trial Master Files (TMFs) and lnvestigator Site Files (ISFs) according to Octapharma SOPs

Assume Data Protection / Information Security Champion responsibilities  
Assists in development of SOPs  
Perform vendor evaluation and oversight for selected vendors

Fluent in both written and spoken English; preferably also in German

Excellent command of Microsoft Office applications and Adobe Acrobat DC

Executive Assistant \- LE4 \- DFAT \- Geneva  
About The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade  
The role of the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) is to advance the interests of Australia and Australians internationally. This involves strengthening Australia’s security, enhancing Australia’s prosperity, delivering an effective and high\-quality overseas aid program and helping Australian travellers and Australians overseas. The department provides foreign, trade and development policy advice to the Australian Government. DFAT also works with other Australian Government agencies to drive coordination of Australia’s pursuit of global, regional and bilateral interests.  
About the Position  
Under direction, the Executive Assistant to the Ambassador and Deputy Ambassador provides high\-level executive, administrative and organisational support at the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva. The position also organises official events and functions.  
Due to the sensitive nature of the work involved, this position will need to be able to hold and maintain a national security clearance recognised by DFAT.  
Key responsibilities of the position include but are not limited to:  
Provide high\-level executive support to the Ambassador and Deputy Ambassador, ensuring the effective operation of executive offices in a fast\-paced and sensitive environment.  
Manage and prioritise correspondence, invitations, briefing materials and requests, exercising sound judgement to determine priority, action and compliance requirements.  
Coordinate official visits and delegation programs for Ministers, senior officials and high\-level visitors, balancing competing priorities and operational requirements.  
Plan and deliver representational events, meetings and official engagements, liaising with internal and external stakeholders to achieve Mission objectives.  
Manage representational expenditure and financial administration, including forecasting, acquittals, reconciliations and reporting in accordance with DFAT policies and procedures.  
Coordinate travel, logistics and related administrative arrangements for executive leadership and official activities, ensuring compliance with relevant policies and procedures.  
Monitor security, operational and workflow risks, implementing required controls and escalating issues as appropriate.  
Provide administrative guidance, maintain effective business systems and support team coordination, contributing to continuous improvement and organisational effectiveness.  
Required Qualifications/Experience/Knowledge/Skills  
Proven experience in similar Executive Assistant role/s  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills  
Ability to work with and support a team. Ability to develop and maintain respectful and effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders  
Ability to manage time, prioritise, plan, handle multiple tasks and work well under pressure  
Financial management and organisational skills  
Discretion and sound judgement in handling confidential information  
Extensive experience using Microsoft Office and electronic applications  
Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills  
Fluency in English is required, with fluency in French highly regarded  
Knowledge of, or an ability to quickly acquire a knowledge of Australian Government legislation or departmental policy and guidelines in relation to the position duties  
Desirable  
Previous experience working in an embassy, international organisation, or comparable environment.  
Security Requirements  
Australian NV2 security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain this. Therefore applicants must hold Australian citizenship to be considered.  
Please note that candidates who hold citizenship or dual citizenship of Switzerland are not eligible for an Australian Security Clearance.  
How to Apply  
Where the application form asks for a cover letter, please provide a written pitch of no more than 500 words demonstrating your suitability to perform the key responsibilities of the position. Your pitch is your opportunity to tell us why you are the right candidate for the role. Laboratory Technician 80\-100%

Perform chemical analyses using ICP\-OES and ICP\-MS, with occasional support for GC\-MS and LC\-MS measurements

Ensure safe, organized, and efficient laboratory operations  
Assist in training and supporting apprentices, interns, students, and researchers in analytical techniques

Degree or professional qualification in chemistry with higher professional examination for chemical laboratory technicians, or equivalent expertise  
Extensive practical experience in ICP\-OES and ICP\-MS, including sample preparation, method development, troubleshooting, and data interpretation  
Basic to intermediate experience with GC\-MS and LC\-MS analytical techniques  
Good computer skills, particularly in analytical and spectroscopy data processing software  
Very good command of English, German is desirable  
We offer  
Our institution is based on an interdisciplinary, innovative and dynamic collaboration. You will profit from a systematic training on the job, in addition to personal development possibilities and our pronounced vocational training culture. If you wish to optimally combine work and family life or other personal interests, we are able to support you with our modern employment conditions and the on\-site infrastructure.

description:
At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.  
We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams  
and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.  
Manager \- Tax Services \- Indirect Tax/VAT (Zug or Luzern)  
The opportunity  
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your voice and perspective to help EY become even better too.  
We are market leaders in numerous tax services and advise our clients on all tax issues. We optimize the business and legal structures of our global customers and support a healthy development of our clients, from renowned multinational companies to flourishing startups.  
Develop your individual skills in interdisciplinary and multicultural teams with us in our offices in Zug or Luzern! Indirect taxes operate in an extremely dynamic environment in which numerous changes are constantly planned and implemented \- help us and our customers to master the challenges ahead.  
Embark on your next journey and join our unique Indirect Tax Team to help solve exciting problems on a daily basis!  
Your key responsibilities  
Ensure compliance with indirect tax rules on a local and global scale, supporting diverse clients across all industries, from manufactured products to real estate and financial activities  
Address the complexities of a constantly evolving tax landscape, keeping abreast with e\-commerce VAT rules, and rapidly spreading e\-invoicing requirements  
Focus on increased VAT efficiency within supply chains and support clients in transitioning to a digitalized world  
Be a key pilar of our team growth, supporting and training our more junior colleagues and managing your projects from identifying clients' needs to delivering our recommendations  
Collaborate with our global network of Indirect tax experts dedicated to delivering holistic, practice\-oriented solutions  
Work closely with colleagues in Tax, Assurance, and Advisory Services to comprehensively meet clients' needs and offer innovative solutions  
Tackle complex Swiss and international tax questions within an interdisciplinary environment, fostering constant learning opportunities and personal development  
Engage in exciting projects at the intersection of business and law, gaining deep insights into various industries and business areas through daily client interactions and communication with tax authorities

A recognized diploma in Law and/or Economics, preferably obtained from a Swiss University or equivalent foreign diploma; certified Tax Expert recognition is considered an asset  
5 to 7 years of experience in indirect tax consulting, preferably gained at one of the Big4 or a comparable consulting firm, either in Switzerland or internationally; additional experience as an in\-house VAT advisor is considered a valuable asset  
Proven track record as a manager who has responsibly handled client mandates and guided less experienced colleagues through complex projects  
Fluent in German and English, essential for our international company operations; proficiency in other foreign languages is highly appreciated

Thrive in a great working environment where your proactive approach to career development is encouraged and supported

At EY, we'll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

title: Sachbearbeiter immobilienbewirtschaftung / Vermietungsspezialist , St. Jakob-Park Basel, 50%
description:
Sachbearbeiter Immobilienbewirtschaftung / Vermietungsspezialist (m/w/d), St. \-Park Basel, 50%  
Inserat abgelaufen? Alle offenen Stellenangebote findest du unter  
Wincasa, der führende Immobilien\-Dienstleister, gestaltet die Zukunft der Immobilienbranche entscheidend mit. Digitale Dienstleistungen, agile Prozesse und eine smarte Arbeitsweise zeichnen uns aus. Werde Teil unserer Transformationsreise und präge die Zukunft von Wincasa aktiv mit. \#Wincasa  
Als vielfältiger Immobilien\-Dienstleister kombinieren wir im Center\- und Mixed Use Site Management Retail Know\-how mit Immobilienexpertise. So übernehmen wir für unsere Kunden die technische und betriebswirtschaftliche Gesamtleitung komplexer Areale \- von Geschäftsliegenschaften über Bürogebäude und Shopping\-Center bis hin zu gemischt genutzten Arealen.  
Neu ergänzen gemischt genutzte Liegenschaften mit über 400 Wohnobjekten unser Portfolio in Basel und Pratteln. Daher suchen wir eine engagierte, offenherzige und verlässliche Persönlichkeit als  
Sachbearbeiter Immobilienbewirtschaftung / Vermietungsspezialist (m/w/d), St. \-Park Basel, 50%  
Das bewegst du in deiner Rolle als Vermietungsspezialist (m/w/d):  
Du steuerst den digitalen Wiedervermietungsprozess vom Kündigungseingang bis zur Objektübergabe an die neuen Mieter, kommunizierst mit Mietern und Interessenten, prüfst Bewerbungen und erstellst Mietverträge  
Du reduzierst Leerstände durch wirkungsvolle Vermarktungsmassnahmen \- von fehlerfreien Online\-Inseraten bis zur Koordination von Fotos und 360°\-Rundgängen  
Du führst selbstständig Besichtigungen, Übergaben und Abnahmen von Wohnungen durch. Bei Bedarf auch ausserhalb der üblichen Arbeitszeiten.  
Das bewegst du in deiner Rolle als Sachbearbeiter (m/w/d):  
Du unterstützt das Bewirtschaftungs\-Team bei administrativen Aufgaben und sorgst für reibungslose Abläufe  
Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit FM\-Providern, Handwerksbetrieben und Ämtern \- inklusive Offerten, Auftragsvergaben und Arbeitskontrolle  
Schlussabrechnungen, Depotauflösungen sowie die Bearbeitung von Kreditoren, Debitoren und Mahnwesen gehören ebenfalls zu deinem Aufgabenbereich  
Deshalb gelingt es dir:  
Du bringst eine kaufmännische Grundausbildung mit; eine Weiterbildung im Bereich Immobilienbewirtschaftung ist von Vorteil oder du bist bereit, diese zu absolvieren  
Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Erfahrung in der Immobilienbranche oder in einer administrativen Funktion mit Kundenkontakt gesammelt  
Du arbeitest strukturiert, behältst auch in hektischen Situationen den Überblick und kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch; Englisch ist ein Plus  
Du bist belastbar, kundenorientiert, teamfähig und mobil mit gültigem Führerausweis  
Der persönliche Kontakt mit Mietern und Mietinteressenten macht dir Freude und die Dienstleistungsorientierung steht bei dir an oberster Stelle  
Hier einige unserer Benefits:  
Arbeitszeiten: Wir leben mobiles Arbeiten mit individueller (Jahres)\-Arbeitszeit und/oder Teilzeitarbeit. Bis zu 40% Home\-Office sind möglich. Work\-Life\-Balance wird bei uns grossgeschrieben, denn ausgeglichene und erholte Mitarbeitende sind uns wichtig. Der Kauf von zusätzlichen Ferien ist möglich.  
Mobilität und Verpflegung: Du erhältst einen Beitrag für das Mobiltelefon. Für deine Verpflegung leisten wir ebenfalls einen Beitrag.  
Aus\- und Weiterbildung: Das Fördern von Mitarbeitenden ist ein wichtiger Bestandteil unserer Kultur. Profitiere von einer grosszügigen Unterstützung bei internen und externen Aus\- und Weiterbildungen. Wir bieten Laufbahnmöglichkeiten in Führungs\-, Fach\- und Projektfunktionen  
Salär: Bei uns erwartet dich eine marktgerechte Entlöhnung mit absoluter Lohngleichheit für alle Geschlechter. Die Pensionskassenleistungen sind attraktiv und du kannst aus verschiedenen Modellen das für dich passende wählen. Die Unfallschutzversicherung deckt die private Spitalabteilung ab.  
Weitere Informationen zu unseren Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.

description:
Sachbearbeiter Kundendienst DE/FR 80\-100% (m/w/d)  
Digital Republic ist der innovative und flexible Provider für Mobile Abos und mobiles Internet in der Schweiz. Als Teil der mobilezone Gruppe arbeiten wir in Zürich (Schlieren) und verfolgen ein klares Ziel: Einfache Produkte mit einem starken Preis\-Leistungs\-Verhältnis und persönlichem Support. Bei uns erwartet dich ein junges und motiviertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, viel Eigenverantwortung und einer offenen Du\-Kultur. Du möchtest mitdenken, mitgestalten und wirklich etwas bewegen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.  
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Zürich (Schlieren) suchen wir dich als  
Sachbearbeiter Kundendienst DE/FR 80\-100% (m/w/d)  
Deine Aufgaben  
Als Mitglied unseres Supportteams bist du bei uns die wichtige Ansprechperson für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und setzt deren Zufriedenheit an erste Stelle. Du hilfst bei Fragen, löst Probleme und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kundinnen und Kunden eine exzellente Erfahrung mit Digital Republic machen.  
Du bearbeitest Kundenanfragen via Telefon und Ticketingsystem auf Deutsch, ösisch und idealerweise auf Englisch.  
Du unterstützt unsere Kundinnen und Kunden bei Fragen und berätst sie proaktiv rund um unsere Mobile\-, Home\- und Daten\-Abos.  
Du gibst Kundenfeedback intern weiter und trägst so zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Abos und interner Prozesse bei.  
Du unterstützt bei Backoffice\-Aufgaben und arbeitest mit anderen Teams innerhalb der Firma zusammen.  
Das bringst du mit  
Eine abgeschlossene Lehre im Bereich /\-frau, Kundendialog oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet  
Du verfügst über mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Kundendienst. Viel wichtiger ist uns aber, dass du gerne mit Menschen kommunizierst, stets freundlich bleibst und auch bei mehreren gleichzeitigen Anfragen den Überblick behältst  
Du schreibst und sprichst fliessend und stilsicher Deutsch und ösisch. Gute Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil  
Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und genau. Du denkst mit und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung  
Deine positive und kommunikative Persönlichkeit zeichnet dich aus und du hast Freude daran, Kundinnen und Kunden wirklich weiterzuhelfen  
Du bist bereit, gelegentlich auch samstags zu arbeiten und dafür unter der Woche zu nehmen  
Das bieten wir dir  
Ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld im Telekommunikationsbereich  
Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit fixen Büro\- und Homeoffice\-Tagen  
Eine kollegiale Atmosphäre mit Du\-Kultur und tollen Teamevents  
Ein kostenloses Digital Republic Mobile Abo  
Attraktive BVG\-Versicherungsleistungen  
Zentrale Lage in ZH (Schlieren) mit sehr guter ÖV\-Anbindung  
Die Möglichkeit, Ideen einzubringen und die Zukunft von Digital Republic aktiv mitzugestalten

description:
Creating impact together at !  
Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.  
aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.  
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start\-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.  
Solution Architect SAP PS \& SD

5\+ years of professional experience, including 3\+ years in SAP solution architecture, development, or a comparable technical SAP role; agile experience (Scrum, SAFe) is a plus  
Deep expertise in SAP PS and/or SD is ideal. What matters most is a strong architectural mindset across SAP modules, so candidates with deep expertise in another area such as FI/CO who bring broad SAP knowledge and a track record of designing integrated solutions are equally encouraged to apply  
Strong hands\-on expertise in ABAP and ABAP OO development, including custom programs, enhancements, BAPIs, and BADIs; BTP, OData, and CDS experience is a plus  
Proven ability to take ownership, proactively drive initiatives and solutions, solve complex problems, and collaborate effectively across technical and business teams, combined with fluent business\-level English

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.  
aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.  
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start\-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.  
Solution Architect (Customer Service Systems)  
We are looking for a hands\-on Solution Architect to design and deliver creative, scalable solutions across our global Customer Service business. In this role, you will shape the architecture of our service processes across SAP S/4HANA, SAP CS, SM \& SD, Service Cloud (C4C V2\), SAP Field Service Management, and Asset Manager. You design and deliver high\-quality solution architectures for the Epics and initiatives you own

You coordinate internal and external development partners, including quality checks and testing  
You independently perform SAP S/4HANA CS/SM/SD/FSM customizing and document system setups  
You support global implementation projects and provide third\-level support for global users  
These are the skills you'll need  
Bachelor's degree in business informatics, computer science, engineering, or a comparable field  
5\+ years of professional experience, including 2\+ years in a similar Solution Architect or Application Manager role  
Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA Customer Service (CS), Sales \& Distribution (SD) as well as experience with Service Management in S/4  
Proven ability to create architecture deliverables in both waterfall and Agile environments  
Fluency in English, with strong communication and collaboration skills  
Questions? We are happy to answer them!

title: Werkstudentin / Werkstudent Administration Klinikinformations-System
description:
Zur Unterstützung unseres IT Business Applikationen Teams suchen wir per sofort eine/n  
Werkstudentin / Werkstudent Administration Klinikinformations\-System  
50\-50%  
Der Querschnittsbereich Innovations\- und Digitalisierungsmanagement (IDM) umfasst die Abteilungen Unternehmensentwicklung und Informatik und bündelt damit bisher eigenständig operierende Bereiche sowie dezentrale Projekte der PDAG. Als Teil der Unternehmensstrategie plant und entwickelt er Innovationen für das Unternehmen und setzt diese eigenständig sowie in Zusammenarbeit mit externen Providern um. Zusätzlich ist er für das Funktionieren und die Weiterentwicklung der IT\-Infrastruktur sowie bestehender und neuer Applikationen, wie zum Beispiel ORBIS, zuständig. Als neugeschaffener Geschäftsbereich trägt der IDM wesentlich zur Zukunftsfähigkeit der PDAG im sich wandelnden Gesundheitswesen bei.  
Profil  
Sie studieren und sind ein immatrikulierter Student/Studentin  
Sie besitzen analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse in den gängigen MS Office\-Produkten (Word, PowerPoint, Excel), Visio ist wünschenswert  
Sie sind verantwortungsbewusst, haben sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Sprache und Schrift  
Sie schätzen die Möglichkeit zu selbstorganisiertem Arbeiten und besitzen die Bereitschaft, sich in eine oder mehrere Fachapplikationen und Thematiken einzuarbeiten  
Sie besitzen Erfahrung in Protokollierung von Meetings / Aufgaben generell  
Aufgaben  
Erfassen, Mutieren und Beenden von Berechtigungen gem. Berechtigungskonzept und Sonderrechten gemäss Auftrag im Klinikinformations\-System (Orbis)  
Erstellen von definierten Auswertungen  
Administrative Tätigkeiten Terminabklärungen, Ablage von Dokumenten, Erstellen von Prozessdiagrammen, Vorgabedokumenten für die Parametrierung, (Projekt)\-Besprechungen  
Protokolle verfassen, Dokumente redigieren  
Erfassen von Stammdaten nach Vorgabe  
Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung von Schulungsunterlage  
Unterstützung der Mitarbeiter im Bereich der Terminverwaltung und dem Erstellen von Textbausteinen  
Benefits  
Unsere Mitarbeitenden sind das Herz unseres Unternehmens. Genau deshalb bieten wir Ihnen auch sehr viel: Weiterbildungen werden bei uns stark gefördert. Ebenfalls investieren wir viel in den Teamzusammenhalt und bieten allen unseren Teams den Zugang zur Software «Moodtalk» an, mit der die Teamkommunikation gestärkt wird. Daneben bieten wir attraktive Vergünstigungen bei bekannten Marken wie Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl und vielen mehr. Mitarbeitende, die mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu uns pendeln, erhalten am Ende des Jahres einen stattlichen Öko\-Bonus ausbezahlt. Zusätzlich bieten wir eine attraktive Pensionskassenlösung an. Auch die Work\-Life\-Balance wird bei uns gefördert: Wir sind jederzeit offen für Teilzeitarbeit und offerieren die Möglichkeit zum Ferienkauf.

title: Social Media & Community Engagement Officer
description:
Join MSF OCG as a Social Media & Community Engagement Officer in Geneva!
We are looking for passionate candidates ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission.
Below, you will find the job details and the qualifications we are looking for.
Inclusivity and Diversity at MSF
Do your qualifications and experience not exactly match all requirements of the job?
At MSF OCG, we are committed to an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff members. We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF's social mission and create better outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with.
We understand that some people may hesitate to apply for employment if they don't meet all listed job requirements. Research shows that this is especially true for women. If you believe your profile is a good match for this position, we invite you to apply even if you don’t fulfil every listed qualification.
We encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, background, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.
MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will undergo reference checks.

Context & mission
Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).
The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers.
The mission is to develop and implement MSF Switzerland's organic social media approach for French-speaking audiences, strengthening audience engagement and supporting broader digital supporter journeys. Ensure social media channels contribute to awareness, engagement, advocacy and supporter acquisition through relevant content, community engagement and platform-specific practices.

Tasks & Responsibilities
Define and implement the organic social media approach : define and implement the organic social media strategy for French-speaking audiences, ensuring channel priorities, editorial choices and audience engagement support MSF Switzerland's digital engagement objectives.
Develop and maintain social media standards and playbooks: develop and continuously improve platform-specific playbooks, editorial standards and community engagement practices to ensure consistency, quality and effective use of social media channels.
Lead social media editorial planning and content adaptation: lead the planning, adaptation and editorial framing of social media content, ensuring messages are relevant, accessible and aligned with audience needs, organisational priorities and platform requirements.
Monitor and optimise social media performance: in collaboration with the digital analyst, analyse performance data, audience insights and engagement trends to identify opportunities, improve content effectiveness and refine social media approaches.
Manage and strengthen online communities: manage community engagement across priority social media channels, fostering meaningful interactions and encouraging audiences to take appropriate actions within the broader digital engagement journey.
Coordinate digital initiatives: coordinate and contribute to digital projects, campaigns and activations, ensuring alignment between social media activities and wider digital communication objectives.
Contribute to digital innovation and knowledge sharing: identify emerging trends, platform developments and best practices, translating insights into recommendations that enhance digital engagement activities and organisational learning.
Supervise and support the Digital Engagement Unit intern: supervise, guide and develop the French-speaking Digital Engagement Unit intern, ensuring quality delivery, skill development and alignment with team priorities.

Your profile
Education
Bachelor's degree in digital communication, digital marketing or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

Experience
Experience in digital communication with a focus on social media management.
Experience developing and implementing organic social media strategies, editorial planning and platform-specific content approaches.
Experience engaging online audiences and supporting digital engagement objectives.
Experience contributing to cross-functional projects and campaigns.
Experience supporting or supervising junior contributors is an asset

Languages
French : fluency.
English : C1.
German is an asset (B1).

Skills/ Technical competencies
Knowledge of organic social media management, particularly Facebook, Instagram and YouTube.
Understanding of audience engagement, content performance and social media analytics.
Understanding of platform trends, content formats and community management practices.
Awareness of humanitarian communication principles and sensitive operational contexts.
Editorial judgement and content adaptation.
Audience engagement and relationship building.
Analytical and problem-solving skills.
Planning and project coordination.
Collaboration and stakeholder management.
Adaptability in changing environments.
Creativity and trends adaptation.

Terms of employment
Full-time position 100% (40h/week)
Open-ended contract
Working place: Geneva
Ideal start date: October 2026
Gross annual salary (for 100%): from CHF 87’372.- to CHF 100’608.- (salary commensurate with equivalent experience and internal salary grid)
Paid vacation: 25 days per year, prorate temporis, plus any Swiss public holidays falling within the contract period.
Pension plan: pension contribution covered 3/4 by MSF, 1/4 by staff member.
Relocation support available for eligible candidates.

How to apply
Candidates are invited to submit their application exclusively through our recruitment platform, following these guidelines:
CV (maximum 2 pages)
Cover letter (maximum 1 page)
Documents must be submitted in either English or French.
The application deadline is September  6th, 2026.

We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier if we receive a sufficient number of quality applications.
All applications will be treated confidentially.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Please note that we do not wish to use the services of recruitment or placement agencies.

title: Clinical Fellowship in Robotic Lymphatic Microsurgery & Lymphatic Biology 80-100%
description:
The Clinic of Plastic Surgery and Hand Surgery at the University Hospital Zurich is providing the full spectrum of plastic and reconstructive surgery, hand surgery, burn care and sarcoma surgery. Our clinic has more than 10 years of experience in lymphatic reconstructive surgery, has been among the earliest adopters of robotic microsurgery worldwide and possesses a solid research foundation, ranging from basic to translational and clinical research.  
Fellowship purpose  
This 3\-6 month advanced fellowship trains surgeons and physician\-scientists in (1\) robotic\-assisted microsurgery / supermicrosurgery workflows and (2\) translational lymphatic biology, with a focus on lymphatic reconstruction. The fellow is integrated into a high\-volume academic plastic surgery service and a structured research program linking surgical innovation to lymphatic science. The fellowship has been designed with a 60% clinical and 40% research focus to maximize the benefits of this dedicated time.  
The Fellowship is unpaid. The accommodation in Zurich will be organized and sponsored by the fellow.  
The language during the Fellowship is English. German language knowledge is found to be helpful.  
Fellowship Types  
Track A: Clinical Fellow Lymphatic Surgery, 6 months (hands\-on clinical practice under supervision). Track A is designed for candidates who can legally participate in patient care in Switzerland, enabling them to have hands\-on clinical practice under supervision.  
Track B: Observership Fellow, 3 months (observer status; no medical practice).  
For candidates who do not meet Swiss recognition/authorization requirements. The observer fellow is fully integrated into the daily clinical routine and operating theater, but without the right to perform in any surgery/ medical procedure.  
The University Hospital of Zurich is one of the largest hospitals in Switzerland. Our more than 8, 600 employees and around 700 trainees work every day for the well\-being of our patients.  
Clinical Fellowship in Robotic Lymphatic Microsurgery \& Lymphatic Biology 80\-100%  
Start date: June 1, 2026 or by agreement  
Your main tasks  
Track A  
\* Supervised participation in outpatient clinics, perioperative care, and operating theatre activities  
\* Progressive clinical entrustment based on competency milestones (assistant ? key procedural steps ? selected cases under direct supervision)  
\* Participation in journal clubs and skills lab training  
\* Active research participation including lab meetings and data presentation  
Track B  
\* Structured shadowing of clinical routine including ward rounds and outpatient clinics (observer role)  
\* Observation in the operating theatre  
\* Participation in journal clubs and skills lab training  
\* Research participation including lab meetings and data presentation  
Both Tracks  
\* Attendance at rounds, conferences, teaching sessions, and educational activities organized by the host clinic  
\* Participation in the core curriculum:  
\* Robotic microsurgery / supermicrosurgery training  
\* Simulation modules (dry\- and wet\-lab)  
\* Case\-based clinical learning  
\* Operating room workflow orientation  
\* Exposure to lymphatic surgery patient evaluation and treatment pathways  
\* Assigned research project(s) based on fellowship duration and qualifications  
\* Scientific mentorship and dedicated research time  
\* Participation in consultations and surgical schedule (as permitted by track status)  
Your profile  
Track A  
\* Medical degree enabling eligibility for clinical participation in Switzerland  
\* Willingness and responsibility to obtain MEBEKO recognition of medical diploma prior to fellowship start  
\* Ability to work in a supervised clinical environment  
\* Interest in lymphatic surgery and microsurgical innovation  
Track B  
\* Medical or scientific background relevant to the fellowship field  
\* Interest in clinical observation and research participation  
\* Eligibility to participate in the fellowship in an observer capacity (no patient care activities)  
Both Tracks  
\* Proficiency in English (working language of the fellowship)  
\* German language skills considered an advantage  
\* Strong motivation to engage in surgical education and research  
\* Interest in lymphatic reconstruction and translational science  
\* Ability to participate in academic meetings, teaching sessions, and research activities  
Benefits  
Supervision  
Named fellowship mentors within the Department of Plastic Surgery and Hand Surgery (USZ):  
Clinical part: Prof. Dr. med. Lindenblatt, Dr. med. Jennifer Ashley Watson, Dr. med.  
Research part: Prof. Dr. med. Lindenblatt, PD Dr. med. Epameinondas Gousopoulos  
Evaluation  
Quarterly review: operative logbook (Track A), skills assessments (simulation), research milestones, and professionalism goals.  
Fellowship completion requirements: (i) documented competency portfolio, (ii) at least one manuscript submitted (or a complete study protocol with ethics submission).  
Deliverables \& Outcome  
Graduates will be able to integrate robotic microsurgical workflows into reconstructive practice and translate lymphatic biology into clinically meaningful innovation. Upon completion of the Fellowship, all Fellows will be part of the Fellows' Academy, a tool of professional networking, future collaborations, and a discussion forum for the future leaders of the field.  
Universitätsspital Zürich  
8091 Zürich

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.  
We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams  
and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
